_note: Step-by-step clues for Cubes and Colouring (Chapter 28): the book questions by question id. Each list says where on the big cube the small cubes asked about sit (corners, edges, faces, inside, or along the edge where two coloured faces meet), gives the count for that place in a cube cut n × n × n, then sets up the sum for this cube. The last clue never gives the answer. tools/check_clues.ts checks them.

col-b01: Each edge is cut into 3 parts, so the big cube is 3 × 3 × 3 small cubes.
Three painted faces meet only at a corner of the big cube. A cube has 8 corners, whatever the size.
So how many small cubes have three faces painted?
col-b02: Each edge is cut into 3 parts, so the big cube is 3 × 3 × 3 small cubes.
Two painted faces meet along an edge. Leave out the 2 corner cubes: each edge has n − 2 such cubes, and a cube has 12 edges.
col-b03: Each edge is cut into 3 parts, so the big cube is 3 × 3 × 3 small cubes.
One painted face only: the middle of a face, away from its edges. Each face has (n − 2)² of these.

No painted face: the cubes hidden inside. Take off one layer on every side, leaving a cube (n − 2) on each edge.
